records.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Make a standalone ink and watercolour educational apparatus plate matching the inspected hollow-cathode lamp's delicate ink edges, grey metallic washes and restrained orange glow. Transparent background with real alpha, square composition and at least 15% clear margin on every side. A graphite furnace atomiser for atomic absorption spectroscopy: side view, horizontal short dark grey graphite tube, roughly half the canvas width, held between two distinct grey metal end contacts. Both ends open along its horizontal axis, with an unobstructed axial bore for an external light beam to pass. A small round sample introduction port on TOP of the tube. Faint orange inner glow indicating heat inside the graphite tube. Show a simple sectional cutaway so the open bore is legible while retaining a clear side view. No flame. No beam, labels or letters painted, these will be added in code. No text, numbers, logos, branding, people, faces or hands. It must read as a heated graphite tube in a holder rather than an ordinary pipe or battery. Only the apparatus, no pedestal or background.
